blocks.summary: Step into a living 17th-century royal legacy at Rawla Narlai, where Aravalli hills meet Rajput grandeur — a rare heritage stay offering leopard safaris, candlelit stepwell dinners, and royal hospitality.

cards.title: Rawla Narlai Luxury Heritage Hotel
cards.why: 17th-century stepwell, leopard safaris, and candlelit dinners in a royal Aravalli retreat

cards.title: Heritage Rooms
cards.why: Authentic Rajput architecture with modern amenities, carved wooden furniture, and courtyard views

cards.title: Deluxe Suites
cards.why: Spacious suites with private balconies, royal decor, and enhanced privacy for families or couples

cards.title: Royal Villa
cards.why: Private villa with dedicated butler, garden access, and exclusive royal treatment

cards.title: Stepwell Dinner
cards.why: Candlelit dinner in a 400-year-old stepwell, served by bullock cart — an unforgettable royal experience

cards.title: Heritage Restaurant
cards.why: Authentic Rajasthani thali, royal feasts, and modern Indian dishes in a heritage setting

cards.title: From Jodhpur
cards.why: Scenic 130km drive through Aravalli hills via NH62 — best taken in morning or late afternoon

cards.title: From Udaipur
cards.why: 122km route through Rajasthan countryside — enjoy views of forts and traditional villages

blocks.conclusion: A truly royal escape best enjoyed October–March when the Aravallis are cool and clear — book the stepwell dinner and safari in advance for the full experience.
